usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover existing LVM volume groups on a node before provisioning new LVM-backed storage. The caller requires the Datastore.Allocate privilege on /storage, so API tokens used for storage setup must hold that permission. Only volume groups already present on the node's block devices are returned — run this before calling the storage creation endpoint to verify the VG name.

examples.summary: List all LVM volume groups on node pve1

tips: The node must be online and reachable within the cluster; scanning a node that is down returns an error rather than an empty list.
Volume group names returned here (the 'vg' field) map directly to the 'vgname' parameter used when creating an LVM storage entry via POST /storage.
If a VG you expect is missing, check that the underlying physical volume is visible to the OS (pvs/vgs in a node shell) — Proxmox scans what the kernel sees at call time.
